findings.title: Sync fan-out writes O(N) UserSyncEvent rows per message
findings.description: Every message creates one sync event row per member. At 1M users this is the primary write bottleneck.
findings.evidence: Sync.append_scope_events(member_ids, ...) inserts N rows per message
findings.recommendation: Replace per-user sync events with shared event log + per-user cursors. Reduces N writes to 1 write per message.

findings.title: No rate limiting on authentication endpoints
findings.description: Login, register, refresh, recover endpoints have zero rate limiting. Enables credential stuffing and Argon2 CPU DoS.
findings.evidence: Grep for rate/throttle returns zero results
findings.recommendation: Add PlugAttack or Hammer rate limiting: login 5/min per username, register 3/min per IP, recovery 3/10min per IP

findings.title: Voice Room GenServer mixes control+data plane
findings.description: Single GenServer handles both join/leave and RTP packet routing. Control ops block data forwarding.
findings.evidence: 25 participants * 50 packets/sec = 1250 msgs/sec through one mailbox
findings.recommendation: Separate RTP forwarding into dedicated process per room. Leave GenServer for control only.

findings.title: Low test coverage across critical paths
findings.description: 7 test files for 100+ source files. Auth, permissions, sync, voice room lifecycle untested.
findings.evidence: test/ directory contains only 7 test files
findings.recommendation: Add tests for auth flows, permission computation, sync cursors, encryption CAS

findings.title: PermissionsCache cold-start thundering herd
findings.description: ETS miss serializes through single GenServer. After restart with 50K members, all channel joins queue behind one process.
findings.recommendation: Shard GenServer by server_id or fall back to direct DB read on miss

findings.title: No rate limit on recovery key verification
findings.description: Recovery endpoints accept hash and return encrypted bundle with no rate limit.
findings.recommendation: Rate limit to 3 attempts per IP per 10 minutes

findings.title: Unlinked attachments accessible to any authenticated user
findings.description: Any auth'd user can download unlinked attachments by UUID. No uploader tracking.
findings.recommendation: Track uploader_id on Attachment schema, restrict to original uploader

findings.title: FileStorage local filesystem prevents horizontal scaling
findings.description: priv/uploads/ with File.cp! — single node only. At 1M users, file storage is bottleneck.
findings.recommendation: Abstract behind behaviour, implement S3-compatible backend with presigned URLs

findings.title: GroupInfo epoch inflation by compromised client
findings.description: No max delta check on epoch. Compromised client can set epoch=999999999 blocking all others.
findings.evidence: publish_group_info accepts any epoch > stored epoch without delta limit
findings.recommendation: Add max epoch delta check (new_epoch <= stored_epoch + 100)

findings.title: Voice room crash loses all state, no recovery
findings.description: restart: :temporary means crash = total state loss. At 1M scale, room crashes are frequent.
findings.recommendation: Change to :transient restart, persist participant list to ETS for recovery
